overview.text: Circle Agent Stack presents USDC infrastructure for agent wallets, service discovery and payments. Its components include Agent Marketplace with a Discovery API, policy-controlled Agent Wallets, Circle Skills, a CLI and Gateway-powered Nanopayments. Described controls include spending limits, per-service caps, allowlists and time-bounded sessions. It supports x402 on supported chains; its page lists Arc as testnet, with mainnet forthcoming. Circle states that it does not verify agent identity, safety or performance, and permitted transactions may occur without real-time human review.
